title: Adding an optional terminal tool: manifest entry drives mounts, shims, and boot copies
answers: How do I add a new command to the PostHog terminal?
Add a tool that installs on first use in the browser terminal
Where are node and pi terminal packages defined?
body:
Optional tools are declared only in `frontend/src/scenes/terminal/terminal-packages.json` (pinned `file`, `sha256`, compressed `size`, unpacked `archiveSize`, `dependencies`, `commands` -> entrypoint).
- `terminalPackages.ts:TerminalPackages.mount` reads it to expose `/posthog/packages/<id>.tar`, the `/posthog/bin/<command>` shell shims and `install-tool`.
- `terminalRuntime.ts` boot script iterates the same manifest to `cp /posthog/bin/<command> /usr/bin/<command>`; no per-tool edit is needed there.
- Archives and recipes live in the external PostHog/terminal-assets repo. `baseUrl` is pinned to a commit, so bumping a tool means updating baseUrl, file, sha256, size and archiveSize together.
- Update the help text in `posthogFilesystem.ts` and the project-structure handbook when user-visible tools change.
applies: frontend/src/scenes/terminal optional tools (node, pi, future additions)
